subject.title: iOS app: node requests re-approval on every reconnect (token persistence bug)

question: Is the private-LAN QR bootstrap persistence fix enough to close this issue, or should an iOS owner first run a current-main LAN/VPN reconnect proof for the manual setup reapproval loop?
rationale: Source and PR evidence prove one overlapping auth-loss path, but the issue reports manual setup too and current gateway code still requests reapproval when the iOS declared node surface changes.

options.title: Require live reconnect proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until current-main or TestFlight iOS pairs once and reconnects repeatedly without creating a new pending node approval.

options.title: Close on partial source proof
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept the QR/bootstrap fix as sufficient despite no proof for the manual setup path.

options.title: Sponsor a focused fix
options.body: If live proof reproduces the loop, route a narrow fix around stable iOS auth and node declaration surfaces.

recommendation.title: Require live reconnect proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until current-main or TestFlight iOS pairs once and reconnects repeatedly without creating a new pending node approval.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent current-source provenance and adjacent mobile bootstrap repair history point to this owner for deciding the proof bar.
